title: Render allocation pie when remaining capacity is zero
objective: Restore the missing Pi chart in the canonical TDTB UI without changing backend capacity semantics. Update the frontend pie model so zero remaining capacity does not hide the chart when allocation segments exist; preserve over-normalization for allocated > total, render an explicit over-capacity state for exhausted days, and keep truly empty allocations hidden.

implementation.pie_model_guard: pieSlices no longer returns [] for every total<=0 day. Guard is now `!cap || cap.total < 0` plus `cap.total === 0 && allocated === 0` returns []. A zero-total day with non-empty segments renders: denominator stays Math.max(cap.total, allocated), so slices normalize to the allocated total (fractions sum to 1, every path non-empty); unallocated computes to 0 and is dropped by the existing blocks>0 filter.
implementation.positive_and_overassignment_untouched: Positive-capacity and overassignment paths unchanged: denominator formula, zero-width segment dropping, segment order, localSelected substitution, and wedgePath all byte-identical in behavior.
implementation.exhausted_day_readout: AllocationPie zero-capacity readout renders 'N blk / of 0 blk capacity / N over' with the existing pie__over-caption 'Over by N blk - trim or drop' (role=status) — explicit overage state. Copy uses block counts only; no 24-hour clock examples introduced. No AllocationPie markup change required; existing readout/caption already satisfy the exhausted-day state.
implementation.backend_capacity_untouched: capacity.total=0 at exhausted EOD preserved server-verbatim; no fake available capacity, no backend source, calculation, or payload edits.

frontend/src/model/pie.test.ts: stays absent when an exhausted day has no allocations
